app.name: karuki
app.tagline: Upload a song, get separated stems, and sing over the backing track

upload.title: Add a song
upload.hint: Any common audio format, up to 8 minutes.
upload.alreadyExisted: This song is already in the library, so it was not processed again.
upload.importHint: The address of an audio file on the web.

player.notReady: This song is not ready to play yet.
player.failed: The stems could not be loaded.

loop.needEnd: Now mark where the section ends.
loop.hint: Mark a section to repeat it over and over.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.loop: Mark the start, the end, or clear the loop
shortcuts.note: The letters are the physical key, so they work on a Hebrew layout too.

queue.title: Tonight's queue
queue.hint: When a song ends the player moves to the next one on its own.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.pending: The words are on their way. Start singing — they will come in as you go.
lyrics.missing: No lyrics for this song yet. You can add them in the editor.

editor.title: Lyrics editor
editor.explain: Fix mistakes in the text. The timings stay as they are, and saving creates a new version — the previous one stays.
editor.empty: No lyrics for this song yet.
editor.wordsDropped: This line loses its word-level highlight
editor.audioReady: Ready to listen and catch times
editor.pastePlaceholder: Paste the words here, one line per line.
editor.pasteExplain: The lines come in untimed; time them with “catch the time” while the song plays.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.twoStemsWhy: Light mode folds drums, bass and other instruments into one channel. Useful when the player stutters.

controls.keyUp: Raise the key by a semitone
controls.keyDown: Lower the key by a semitone

library.title: My library
library.emptyHint: Once you upload a song it will appear here with its processing state.
library.signedOut: Sign in to see your library.

job.playableHint: The lyrics are still loading, but the player is ready

errors.unsupported_format: That file type is not supported. Try MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG or OPUS.
errors.unreadable_audio: The file could not be read as audio. It may be damaged.
errors.no_audio_stream: The file has no audio track.
errors.unknown_duration: The length of the file could not be determined.
errors.song_too_long: The song is longer than 8 minutes. Try a shorter excerpt.
errors.normalisation_failed: The file could not be converted. Try another format.
errors.audio_tooling_missing: Processing is unavailable right now. That is our problem, not your file's.
errors.not_ingested: The song's file is missing. Try uploading it again.
errors.separation_failed: Separating the stems failed. You can try again.
errors.separation_unavailable: Separation is unavailable right now. That is our problem, not your file's.
errors.interrupted: Processing stopped part way through. You can start it again.
errors.not_found: We could not find what you asked for.
errors.job_not_retryable: That job cannot be run again.
errors.database_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.storage_unavailable: Storage is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.processing_unavailable: Processing cannot start right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. You can try again.
errors.upload_not_found: The uploaded file was not found. Try uploading it again.
errors.link_invalid: This file link is no longer valid. Reload the page to get a fresh one.
errors.file_missing: The file is no longer in storage. The song needs processing again.
errors.invalid_lyrics: The lyrics were not saved: a line has a timing that cannot be right. Check the lines and try again.
errors.too_many_lyric_lines: That is too many lines for one song. Up to 1000 can be saved.
errors.lyrics_save_conflict: Another save of these lyrics landed a moment before yours. Try saving again.
errors.lyrics_version_not_found: That version of the lyrics does not exist.
errors.lyrics_match_not_found: The open lyrics database has no timed lyrics for this song. You can type or paste them in the editor.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. You can try again.
errors.upload_failed: The upload did not finish. Try again.
errors.auth_failed: That did not go through. You can try again.
errors.auth_unreachable: The accounts service is unreachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.auth_unconfigured: The accounts service is not configured on this deployment.
errors.bad_credentials: That email or password is not right.
errors.email_taken: There is already an account with that address.
errors.email_unconfirmed: That address still needs confirming. The link was sent to you.
errors.weak_password: That password is too short. Use at least eight characters.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.reset_link_invalid: That reset link is no longer valid. You can ask for a new one.
errors.same_password: That is the password you already have. Choose a different one.
errors.not_signed_in: You need to be signed in to see this.
errors.auth_unavailable: The accounts service is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.monthly_songs_exhausted: You have used this month's new songs. More become available at the start of next month.
errors.storage_full: There is no room for another song. You can free some up on the account screen.
errors.job_already_running: A song is already being processed. Wait for it to finish and then upload the next one.
errors.import_disabled: Importing from a link is switched off here.
errors.import_unavailable: Importing is unavailable right now. That is our problem, not your link's.
errors.import_unsupported_url: That link could not be read. It needs to be an http or https address that leads to audio.
errors.import_unreachable: That address could not be reached. Check the link and try again.
errors.import_forbidden_address: That address points at a private network, so nothing will be fetched from it.
errors.import_not_audio: What is at that address is not an audio file.
errors.import_too_large: The file at that address is too large.
errors.import_incomplete: That link handed over only a fragment of the recording, so it was not imported.
errors.import_failed: The import failed. Try again, or upload a file instead.
errors.song_name_too_long: That name is too long. Up to 200 characters.

auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Follow it and you can sign in.
auth.checkEmailHint: If it has not arrived in a few minutes, look in the spam folder.
auth.resetExplain: We will send a reset link to the address you enter.
auth.resetSent: We sent a reset link to {email}.
auth.setPasswordExplain: Choose a new password, at least eight characters.

account.title: My account
account.freeUpHint: Least played first. Removing one frees its space straight away.
